channel.description: The latest quotes about Arron Afflalo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Derek Fisher on Sasha Vujacic, Robin Lopez, Arron Afflalo
item.description:
“That was a big part of why we specifically went after certain guys in free agency – Robin [Lopez], Arron [Afflalo], guys who can provide that type of leadership and example,’’ Fisher said. Fisher also mentioned re-signing Lance Thomas and Lou Amundson and adding Sasha Vujacic, who has been one of Porzingis’ mentors.“They’re younger, but have a mature approach to their business,”

Derek Fisher on Sasha Vujacic, Robin Lopez, Arron Afflalo, Dec 17, 2015. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Arron Afflalo
item.description:
Phil Jackson on Arron Afflalo:

“Some NBA watchers have questioned whether or not Arron has anything left as he nears his 30th birthday, but I'm positive that he does. He has a gym in his Las Vegas home and he works out religiously. Actually, he's such a hard-worker that he holds his teammates accountable if they try to cut corners in any way. I look for Arron to be a leader on this team. He wanted us and we wanted him, so Arron and the Knicks is a very good match.”

Phil Jackson on Arron Afflalo, Aug 24, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Arron Afflalo
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Terry Stotts on @Arron Afflalo's shoulder:

“He gets better every day. He shot this morning. It's good he's getting some range of motion.”

Terry Stotts on Arron Afflalo, Apr 19, 2015. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.
